## Validation Tab

Monthly, Weekly, and Daily Resolution Sub-Tabs

The resolution tabs contain the user-configurable minimum and maximum limits. Daily and monthly resolutions are supported for all locations. If the Calculate Weekly Totals system option is enabled, the Weekly tab will display.

FLOWCAL validates the net quantity in the given unit and does not perform unit conversions.

Validations are run by the Location Rollup service. They can also be initiated from the [Toolbox](../Tools/Toolbox/Toolbox.md).
